title: Yeluoli: Yue Ling Shi

synonyms: Jingling Meng Yeluoli x Yue Ling Shi
alternative_titles.en: The Fairy Dream of Yeloli: Moon Spirit Stone

synopsis:
At the critical moment when she was on the verge of plunging into the abyss, Xin Ling was rescued by a "mysterious figure" and unexpectedly found herself at the site where Huang Shi was sealed away. However, Huang Shi had sustained severe injuries during the battle, and his primordial spirit was fading. To save him, the Yeluoli Warriors sprang into action, journeying to the fantastical Fairyland to embark on a brand-new adventure. Throughout the mission to rescue Huang Shi, Xin Ling led the children—armed with courage and hope—to once again explore the true meaning of love and growth.

(Source: Mango TV, translated)
